tool_schemas.name: get_coauthors
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided author identity (name, surname, and optional institution/field disambiguators) to a canonical author profile and returns that author’s co-author network as a list of co-author profiles with available provenance/metadata from the latest cached snapshot (results are not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to access author network data, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded, and NOT_FOUND when no canonical author profile can be resolved from the inputs. Raises CONFLICT when the inputs match multiple plausible authors and the optional disambiguators are insufficient to select a single profile, or when the profile exists but co-author data is unavailable for the current snapshot state.

tool_schemas.name: get_author_keywords
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the provided author identity (name, surname, and optional institution disambiguator) to a canonical author profile and returns the author’s extracted research keywords/areas from the latest cached Google Scholar snapshot with available provenance (results are not paginated). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not permitted to access keyword data, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits are exceeded, and NOT_FOUND when no canonical author profile can be resolved from the inputs. Raises CONFLICT when the inputs match multiple plausible authors and the optional disambiguator is insufficient to select a single profile, or when the profile exists but keyword extraction is unavailable for the current snapshot state.

tool_schemas.name: resolve_author
tool_schemas.description: Resolves an input identity (given/family name plus optional institution/field hints) to exactly one canonical active author profile, transparently following merged records. Returns the resolved author record when unique; refuses with not_found when no match exists and ambiguous_author when multiple candidates remain after applying deterministic tie-break rules.

name.description: Author given name (or first name token(s)); must be non-blank.

surname.description: Author family name (surname); must be non-blank.

institution.description: Optional institution hint used to disambiguate against current affiliations (case/whitespace-insensitive match).

field.description: Optional field/area hint used to disambiguate against author primary_field and active keywords (case-insensitive token match).

allow_inactive.description: When false, resolution returns only active canonical authors (merged are followed; disabled are excluded). When true, may return disabled authors as well.

tool_schemas.name: list_authors
tool_schemas.description: Lists canonical author profiles with optional filtering and pagination. Returns only authors matching the supplied filters; refuses invalid pagination parameters.

q.description: Optional free-text search over normalized_full_name (implementation-defined matching).

given_name.description: Filter by given_name (case-insensitive exact match after normalization).

family_name.description: Filter by family_name (case-insensitive exact match after normalization).

google_scholar_profile_id.description: Filter by Google Scholar profile identifier (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of authors to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_author
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single author profile by id. If the author is merged, returns the active canonical author the record was merged into (unless follow_merges=false). Refuses with not_found when the id does not exist.

follow_merges.description: When true, merged authors are transparently resolved to their merged_into_author_id before returning.

tool_schemas.name: create_profile_fetch_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or reuses) a profile fetch job for the supplied normalized input and provider to refresh cached author/coauthor/keyword snapshots. If an unexpired succeeded job already exists for the same cache_key and reuse_if_fresh=true, returns that existing job instead of enqueuing a new fetch. Refuses when provider is unsupported or required fields are blank.

name.description: Query given name (as provided by the caller); must be non-blank.

surname.description: Query family name (as provided by the caller); must be non-blank.

institution.description: Optional query institution used for cache_key and provider disambiguation.

field.description: Optional query field used for cache_key and provider disambiguation.

provider.description: External source provider to fetch from.

reuse_if_fresh.description: When true, reuses an existing unexpired succeeded job for the same cache_key instead of creating a new job.

force_refresh.description: When true, creates a new job even if a fresh succeeded job exists (may be rate-limited).

tool_schemas.name: get_profile_fetch_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single profile fetch job by id, including its current status and resolution outcome. Refuses with not_found when the id does not exist.
